- ใช้ข้อมูลสาเหตุการตายจากแฟ้ม DEATH Field CDEATH
- เพศ Error คือ รหัสเพศที่ไม่เป็น 1 หรือ 2 สาเหตุอาจเกิดจาก
   1. การบันทึกข้อมูลไม่ถูกต้อง
   2. การเชื่อมโยงไปหาแฟ้มประชากร(PERSON)ไม่ได้ ทำให้ไม่สามารถระบุเพศได้

other.query: SELECT REPLACE(c.diagcode, ' ', '') as a_code, REPLACE(c.diseasethai, ',', '') as a_name, SUM( CASE WHEN sex = '1' THEN result ELSE '0' END ) AS male, SUM( CASE WHEN sex = '2' THEN result ELSE '0' END ) AS female, SUM( CASE WHEN sex not in ('1', '2') THEN result ELSE '0' END ) AS sex_error, SUM(result) AS total FROM cdisease as c INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM {{S_TABLE}} as s inner join chospital_regis as h on h.hoscode = s.hospcode LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE s.id = {{REPORT_ID}} AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} and {{ZONE_CODE}} in (h.zone_code, 'ALL') and {{PROVINCE_CODE}} in (h.chw_code, 'ALL') and {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.amp_code, 'ALL') and {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} in (h.tmb_code, 'ALL') and {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} in (ccmihosp.splevel, 'ALL') AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) and {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} in (h.dep, 'ALL') ) as s ON c.diagcode = s.diagcode WHERE LEFT(REPLACE(c.diagcode, ' ', ''), 1) <> 'Z' GROUP BY c.diagcode, c.diseasethai ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10

rows.query_areacode:
SELECT 
		REPLACE(c.diagcode, ' ', '') as a_code, 
		REPLACE(c.diseasethai, ',', '') as a_name, 
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex='1' THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS male,
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex='2' THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS female,
		SUM(CASE WHEN sex not in(1,2) THEN result ELSE 0 END) AS sex_error,		
		SUM(result) AS total
FROM	cdisease as c	INNER JOIN 
	( 
	SELECT *  FROM	{tablename} as s {jointable} {joinwith} 
	WHERE  s.id='{reportid}' AND s.b_year = '{year}' 
	) as s ON c.diagcode =s.diagcode  
WHERE 1=1 {where}
GROUP BY	1 
HAVING LEFT(a_code,1) <> 'Z'
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 10
